ON-02.title: Permission denied then granted and retried
ON-02.blocker: Permission denial and later regrant require controlling Android system settings and a separate permission-state reset; not implemented in this runner.

ON-07.title: Accept and reject replacement-card merge
ON-07.blocker: The UI has a one-way Merge action but no reject action; acceptance/rejection needs separate, disposable identities and interactive branch handling.

ON-08.title: Rename, edit limit, deselect, and persist
ON-08.blocker: Rename, credit-limit editing, deselection, and persistence need record-level UI locators; not yet automated in this onboarding runner.

ON-10.title: Shuffled historical event order
ON-10.blocker: The emulator SMS injection API stamps receipt time; deterministic out-of-order historical timestamps need provider-level fixture control.

ON-12.title: Import statement and paired payment history
ON-12.blocker: Statement/payment de-duplication during bulk history import lacks a reviewed end-to-end fixture and exact visible statement oracle.

ON-13.title: Bulk ATM withdrawal source and cash behavior
ON-13.blocker: Bulk-mode ATM cash behavior needs an isolated account/cash balance oracle after import; not yet implemented.

ON-14.title: Deselect account and assign its unlinked transactions
ON-14.blocker: Requires deselecting one discovered account and verifying an unlinked record banner plus later account reassignment.

ON-15.title: Keyword versus AI classification phase
ON-15.blocker: Keyword-versus-AI phase telemetry is not exposed in onboarding UI; service use cannot be proven black-box with a deterministic oracle.

ON-16.title: AI correction changes expense to income
ON-16.blocker: AI correction requires a deterministic model response or test service oracle; not safe to assert against a live model.

ON-17.title: Interrupt and resume multi-message import
ON-17.blocker: A mid-import process interruption needs a deterministic pause hook and a known recovery checkpoint, neither exposed by the app UI.
